name: Fortune Teller / 占卜师
ability_text: Up to 2 times per game, choose 2 players at night. The GM tells you SAME FACTION or DIFFERENT FACTION.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Detective / 侦探
ability_text: Once per game at night, investigate 1 player. The GM answers GOOD or NOT GOOD. Shadow Mage counts as NOT GOOD.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: White Witch / 白女巫
ability_text: Once per game at night, protect 1 player from a normal Evil night kill. You cannot protect yourself.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Night Watcher / 守夜人
ability_text: Once per game, after night actions choose 1 player. Learn whether that player used a personal Role Skill that night. The normal Evil faction kill does not count as a personal Role Skill.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Ghost / 幽灵
ability_text: When eliminated, you may give one final statement of about 10 seconds before leaving the main game.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Black Cat / 黑猫
ability_text: The first normal Evil night kill against you fails. Daytime vote elimination still kills you normally.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Pumpkin King / 南瓜王
ability_text: Once per game before a daytime vote, activate this ability. Your vote counts as 2 votes for that round.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Mummy / 木乃伊
ability_text: Once per game at night, curse 1 player. That player may still speak the next Day, but their vote does not count.
win_condition: Good wins if all 3 Evil players are eliminated before the Final Bell.

name: Werewolf / 狼人
ability_text: While alive, you are the Pack Leader for the Evil night kill. Once per game, Blood Moon makes the Evil night kill ignore normal protection or night-kill immunity, including White Witch Protection and Black Cat Nine Lives. If you die, the remaining Evil players can still perform the normal Evil night kill.
win_condition: Evil wins if all 4 God roles OR all 4 Civilian roles are eliminated.

name: Masked Guest / 蒙面客
ability_text: The first faction investigation against you treats you as GOOD. After that first investigation, the disguise breaks and later investigations reveal Evil normally.
win_condition: Evil wins if all 4 God roles OR all 4 Civilian roles are eliminated.

name: Spider Queen / 蜘蛛女王
ability_text: Once per game at night, choose 1 player. That player's personal Role Skill fails that Night. Web does not cancel normal speaking, daytime voting, or the Evil faction night kill.
win_condition: Evil wins if all 4 God roles OR all 4 Civilian roles are eliminated.

name: Shadow Mage / 影法师
ability_text: Current playtest ability: once per game, activate at Night. If targeted by a normal Evil night kill that Night, you survive. Daytime vote elimination still kills you.
win_condition: Survive until the Final Bell. If alive when it rings, trigger the Shadow Ending and win alone.
